rows.source_ko: 산업통상부 (석유산업과), 044-203-5226
rows.text_en: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources ( Petroleum Industry Division ), 044-203-5226
Chapter 1 General Provisions <Amended May 1, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「석유 및 석유대체연료 사업법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Petroleum and Alternative Fuel Business Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(일반판매소) 「석유 및 석유대체연료 사업법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제2조제3호 전단 및 제4호 후단에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 일반판매소”란 면(面) 지역에 있는 일반판매소 중 산업통상부장관이 정하여 고시하는 전산보고의 방법으로 거래상황을 주(週) 단위로 「석유 및 석유대체연료 사업법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제25조의2에 따라 설립된 한국석유관리원(이하 “한국석유관리원”이라 한다)에 보고하는 일반판매소를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (General Sales Outlets) In the first sentence of Article 2, subparagraph 3, and the latter sentence of subparagraph 4, of the Enforcement Decree of the Petroleum and Alternative Fuel Business Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree"), "general sales outlets prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources" means general sales outlets located in myeon (township) areas that, by the computerized reporting method determined and publicly notified by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, report their transaction status weekly to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority established under Article 25-2 of the Petroleum and Alternative Fuel Business Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly added on Dec. 26, 2016.]
[Former Article 2 was moved to Article 2-2 <Dec. 26, 2016>]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(이동판매 및 배달판매) ① 영 제2조제3호 후단, 제4호 후단 및 제9호 후단에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 이동판매의 방법”이란 적재용량 5킬로리터 이하의 차량에 주유기를 부착하여 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자에게 직접 판매하는 것을 말한다. <개정 2023. 4. 21., 2024. 8. 7., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Mobile Sales and Delivery Sales) ① In the latter part of Subparagraph 3 , Subparagraph 4, and Subparagraph 9 of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “method of mobile sales prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” refers to direct sales to any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs by attaching a fuel dispenser to a vehicle with a loading capacity of 5 kiloliters or less. <Amended Apr. 21, 2023; Aug. 7, 2024; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 실소비자(「자동차관리법」 제2조제1호에 따른 자동차와 「건설기계관리법」 제2조제1항제1호에 따른 건설기계 중 덤프트럭 및 콘크리트믹서트럭의 연료유로 사용하는 소비자는 제외하되, 「자동차관리법」 제70조제7호 또는 「도로교통법」 제2조제22호가목에 따른 자동차로서 산업통상부장관이 정하여 고시하는 자동차의 연료유로 사용하는 소비자와 「도로법 시행령」 제79조제2항제1호 또는 제2호에 따른 차량의 연료유로 사용하는 소비자는 실소비자에 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Actual consumers (excluding consumers who use it as fuel oil for dump trucks and concrete mixer trucks among automobiles under Article 2 , Subparagraph 1 of the Automobile Management Act and construction machinery under Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Construction Machinery Management Act ; provided, however, consumers who use it as fuel oil for automobiles designated and notified by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources as automobiles under Article 70 , Subparagraph 7 of the Automobile Management Act or Article 2, Subparagraph 22, Item (a) of the Road Traffic Act , and consumers who use it as fuel oil for vehicles under Article 79, Paragraph 2 , Subparagraph 1 or 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Road Act are included in the actual consumers)

rows.source_ko: 2. 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 석유판매업자
rows.text_en: 2. Petroleum retailers classified according to the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 영 제2조제3호 후단에 따른 이동판매: 주유소
rows.text_en: a. Mobile sales pursuant to the latter part of Article 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree: Gas stations

rows.source_ko: 나. 영 제2조제4호 후단에 따른 이동판매: 일반판매소
rows.text_en: B. Mobile sales pursuant to the latter part of Article 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree: General sales outlets

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제2조제4호 후단에 따른 배달판매의 방법은 계량용기(「계량에 관한 법률 시행령」 별표 7 제10호에 따른 눈새김 탱크를 말한다)를 이용하여 실소비자(제1항에 따른 실소비자를 말한다)에게 배달판매하는 것을 말한다. <개정 2015. 7. 29., 2023. 4. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② The method of delivery sales pursuant to the latter part of Subparagraph 4 of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree refers to delivery sales to actual consumers (referring to actual consumers pursuant to Paragraph 1) using a measuring container (referring to a graduated tank pursuant to Subparagraph 10 of Annex 7 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Measurement). <Amended July 29, 2015; April 21, 2023>

[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]
[Moved from Article 2 <December 26, 2016>]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의3(친환경정제원료) 법 제2조제3호의2에서 “산업통상부령으로 정한 것”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 것을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1., 2026. 8. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-3 (Environmentally Friendly Refined Raw Materials) The term “as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” in Article 2, Subparagraph 3-2 of the Act refers to any of the following: <Amended Oct. 1, 2025; Aug. 27, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「폐기물관리법 시행규칙」 제4조의2 및 제14조의3에 따라 석유 또는 석유화학제품의 원료물질로 재활용할 수 있는 폐기물 및 이를 원료로 제조한 물질
rows.text_en: 1. Waste that can be recycled as raw materials for petroleum or petrochemical products pursuant to Articles 4-2 and 14-3 of the Enforcement Rules of the Waste Management Act, and materials manufactured using such waste as raw materials

rows.source_ko: 2. 「재생에너지 개발ㆍ이용ㆍ보급 촉진법」 제2조제2호바목에 따른 바이오에너지의 원료물질로 활용할 수 있는 생물자원 및 이를 원료로 제조한 물질
rows.text_en: 2. Biological resources that can be utilized as raw materials for bioenergy pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 2, Item ( f) of the Act on Promotion of Development, Utilization, and Dissemination of Renewable Energy, and substances manufactured using these as raw materials

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 산업통상부장관이 정하여 고시하는 물질
rows.text_en: 3. Other substances designated and notified by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 7, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(석유화학제품) 법 제2조제10호나목에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 것”이란 나프타, 액화석유가스 또는 천연가스 등을 원료로 하여 나프타 분해공정, 벤젠ㆍ톨루엔ㆍ크실렌 추출공정 또는 합성가스 생산공정을 거쳐 생산된 탄화수소 물질(탄화수소와 그 밖의 물질과의 혼합물을 포함한다)을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2016. 12. 26., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Petrochemical Products) In Article 2, Subparagraph 10 , Item (b) of the Act , the term “as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” refers to hydrocarbon substances (including mixtures of hydrocarbons with other substances) produced using naphtha, liquefied petroleum gas, or natural gas, etc., as raw materials through a naphtha cracking process, a benzene, toluene, or xylene extraction process, or a synthesis gas production process. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Dec. 26, 2016; Oct. 1, 2025>

[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]
[This Article Newly Inserted August 12, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(석유대체연료 판매업의 취급 석유대체연료) ① 영 제2조제8호에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 연료”란 바이오디젤, 바이오중유, 바이오항공유, 바이오메탄올, 바이오에탄올, 재생합성디젤, 재생합성항공유, 재생합성메탄올, 재생합성가솔린, 유화연료유, 디메틸에테르를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Petroleum Substitute Fuels Handled by Petroleum Substitute Fuel Sales Business) ① The term “fuels prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” in Article 2, subparagraph 8 of the Enforcement Decree refers to biodiesel, bio-heavy oil, bio-aviation fuel, biomethanol, bioethanol, regenerated synthetic diesel, regenerated synthetic aviation fuel, regenerated synthetic methanol, regenerated synthetic gasoline, emulsified fuel oil, and dimethyl ether. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제2조제9호에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 연료”란 바이오디젤, 바이오에탄올, 재생합성디젤, 재생합성가솔린을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In subparagraph 9 of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, “fuels prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” refers to biodiesel, bioethanol, renewable synthetic diesel, and renewable synthetic gasoline. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제2조제10호에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 연료”란 유화연료유를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In subparagraph 10 of Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, “fuel prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” refers to emulsified fuel oil. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly inserted on Aug. 7, 2024.]
[Formerly Article 3-2 was moved to Article 3-3 <Aug. 7, 2024>]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(농ㆍ어업용 화물자동차) 영 제2조제11호나목1) 단서에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 농업용 화물자동차 및 어업용 화물자동차”란 「농ㆍ축산ㆍ임ㆍ어업용 기자재 및 석유류에 대한 부가가치세 영세율 및 면세적용 등에 관한 특례규정 시행규칙」 별표 2 제45호에 따른 농업용 화물자동차 및 같은 규칙 별표 4 제1호에 따른 어업용 화물자동차를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Cargo Vehicles for Agriculture and Fisheries) In the proviso to Subparagraph (b) 1) of Article 2, Item 11 of the Enforcement Decree, the phrase “agricultural cargo vehicles and fisheries cargo vehicles prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” refers to agricultural cargo vehicles under Item 45 of Annex 2 of the Enforcement Rules on Special Provisions for the Application of Zero-Rate and Exemption from Value Added Tax on Equipment and Petroleum Products for Agriculture, Livestock, Forestry, and Fisheries, and fisheries cargo vehicles under Item 1 of Annex 4 of the same Rules. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

[This Article newly added Aug. 12, 2014]
[Moved from Article 3-2, former Article 3-3 deleted <Aug. 7, 2024>]

rows.source_ko: 제2장 석유사업
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Oil Business

rows.source_ko: 제4조(석유정제업의 등록 및 변경등록) ① 법 제5조제1항 전단에 따라 석유정제업의 등록을 하려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 석유정제업 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 사업계획서(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Registration and Change of Registration of Petroleum Refining Business) ① A person who intends to register a petroleum refining business pursuant to the first part of Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for registration of a petroleum refining business in the form of Annex No. 1 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) attached with a business plan (including an electronic document) to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority. <Amended Dec. 26, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제5조제1항 후단에 따라 석유정제업의 변경등록을 하려는 자는 영 제7조 각 호의 사항이 변경된 날부터 30일 이내에 별지 제2호서식의 석유정제업 변경등록신청서에 변경내용을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 8. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to register a change of petroleum refining business pursuant to the latter part of Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for registration of a change of petroleum refining business in the form of Annex 2, attached with documents proving the details of the change, to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority within 30 days from the date on which the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 7 of the Enforcement Decree are changed. <Amended Aug. 12, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 또는 제2항에 따른 신청을 받은 한국석유관리원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(제1항에 따른 신청에서는 법인인 경우만 해당하고, 제2항에 따른 신청에서는 영 제7조제2호의 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2, shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act (applicable only to cases of a corporation in the application pursuant to Paragraph 1, and applicable only to cases under Article 7, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree in the application pursuant to Paragraph 2). <Amended Dec. 16, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항의 사업계획서에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The business plan referred to in Paragraph 1 shall include the following items:

rows.source_ko: 1. 석유정제시설의 현황 자료 또는 건설 및 보유계획(소재지, 정제공정 및 정제능력을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Current status data of petroleum refining facilities or plans for construction and ownership (including location, refining process, and refining capacity)

rows.source_ko: 2. 석유저장시설의 현황 자료 또는 건설 및 보유계획(소재지 및 저장능력을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Current status data of petroleum storage facilities or plans for construction and ownership (including location and storage capacity)

rows.source_ko: 3. 해당 연도 이후 5년간의 석유 수급계획(생산, 수출입 및 판매 계획을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Oil supply and demand plan for the five years following the relevant year (including production, import/export, and sales plans)

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항 또는 제2항에 따른 신청을 받은 한국석유관리원은 그 신청내용을 확인하고 그 결과를 산업통상부장관에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority that receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2 shall verify the contents of the application and notify the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources of the results. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제5항에 따른 통지를 받은 산업통상부장관은 석유정제업의 등록 또는 변경등록을 한 경우에는 해당 신청인에게 별지 제2호의2서식의 석유정제업 등록증을 발급하거나 재발급(석유정제업 등록증의 기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)하고 그 사실을 한국석유관리원에 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Upon receiving the notice pursuant to Paragraph 5, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources shall, in the event that registration or change of registration of a petroleum refining business has been completed, issue or reissue a Certificate of Registration for Petroleum Refining Business in the form of Annex 2-2 to the relevant applicant (only applicable if the details on the Certificate of Registration for Petroleum Refining Business have been changed), and notify the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority of such fact. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제6항에 따른 통지를 받은 한국석유관리원은 별지 제2호의3서식의 석유정제업 등록대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority that has received the notice pursuant to Paragraph 6 shall record the fact in the petroleum refining business registration ledger in the form of Annex 2-3 .
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(석유정제업의 신고 및 변경신고) ① 법 제5조제2항 전단에 따라 석유정제업의 신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 석유정제업 신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 사업계획서(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Notification of Petroleum Refining Business and Notification of Change) ① A person who intends to report a petroleum refining business pursuant to the first part of Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit a petroleum refining business report form (including a report form in electronic form) in Annex No. 1, along with a business plan (including an electronic document), to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제5조제2항 후단에 따라 석유정제업의 변경신고를 하려는 자는 영 제8조제2항 각 호의 사항이 변경된 날부터 30일 이내에 별지 제2호서식의 석유정제업 변경신고서에 변경내용을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 8. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to report a change in petroleum refining business pursuant to the latter part of Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit a report on the change of petroleum refining business in the form of Annex 2, attached with documents proving the details of the change, to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority within 30 days from the date on which the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree are changed. <Amended Aug. 12, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 또는 제2항에 따른 신고를 받은 한국석유관리원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(제1항에 따른 신고에서는 법인인 경우만 해당하고, 제2항에 따른 신고에서는 영 제8조제2항제2호의 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving a report pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2, shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act (applicable only to cases of a corporation in the report pursuant to Paragraph 1, and applicable only to cases under Article 8, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree in the report pursuant to Paragraph 2). < Amended Dec. 16 , 2010>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항의 사업계획서에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The business plan referred to in Paragraph 1 shall include the following items:

rows.source_ko: 1. 석유정제시설의 현황 자료 또는 건설 및 보유계획(소재지, 정제공정 및 정제능력을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Current status data of petroleum refining facilities or plans for construction and ownership (including location, refining process, and refining capacity)

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 연도 이후 5년간의 석유 수급계획(생산, 수출입 및 판매 계획을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Oil supply and demand plan for the five years following the relevant year (including production, import/export, and sales plans)

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 한국석유관리원은 제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따라 석유정제업의 신고 또는 변경신고를 받은 경우에는 해당 신고인에게 별지 제2호의4서식의 석유정제업(아스팔트ㆍ윤활기유ㆍ윤활유) 신고확인증(이하 “석유정제업 신고확인증”이라 한다)을 발급하거나 재발급(석유정제업 신고확인증의 기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)하고 별지 제2호의5서식의 석유정제업(아스팔트ㆍ윤활기유ㆍ윤활유) 신고대장(이하 “석유정제업 신고대장”이라 한다)에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ When the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority receives a report or a change report of petroleum refining business in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 1 through 3, it shall issue or reissue a petroleum refining business (asphalt, lubricating base oil, lubricating oil) report confirmation certificate in Form No. 2-4 of the attached annex (hereinafter referred to as the “petroleum refining business report confirmation certificate”) to the relevant reporter (only applicable if the details on the petroleum refining business report confirmation certificate have been changed) and record the fact in the petroleum refining business (asphalt, lubricating base oil, lubricating oil) report ledger in Form No. 2-5 of the attached annex (hereinafter referred to as the “petroleum refining business report ledger”).
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(석유정제업의 저장시설 범위) ① 영 제9조제5항에 따른 저장시설은 석유정제업의 등록을 하려는 자 또는 등록을 한 자가 소유하거나 1년 이상의 기간을 정하여 독점적으로 사용하기 위하여 임차한 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 시설을 말한다. <개정 2011. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Scope of Storage Facilities for Petroleum Refining Business) ① Storage facilities under Article 9 , Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree refer to any of the facilities falling under any of the following subparagraphs, which are owned by or leased for exclusive use for a fixed period of one year or more by a person intending to register or who has registered a petroleum refining business. <Amended Dec. 30, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「위험물안전관리법」 제6조제1항에 따른 설치허가를 받은 저장소(이동탱크저장소는 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Storage facilities that have received installation permission pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 1 of the "Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act" (excluding mobile tank storage facilities)

rows.source_ko: 2. 「고압가스 안전관리법」 제3조제3호에 따른 저장탱크 중 석유가스나 천연가스를 저장하는 석유저장시설
rows.text_en: 2. Petroleum storage facilities storing petroleum gas or natural gas among storage tanks under Article 3 , Subparagraph 3 of the High-Pressure Gas Safety Management Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「액화석유가스의 안전관리 및 사업법 시행규칙」 제2조제1항제2호 및 제3호에 따른 저장탱크 및 소형저장탱크
rows.text_en: 3. Storage tanks and small storage tanks pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on Safety Management and Business of Liquefied Petroleum Gas

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항을 적용할 때 석유정제업의 등록을 하려는 자 또는 등록을 한 자가 법 제17조제2항에 따른 석유비축대행업자(이하 “석유비축대행업자”라 한다)에게 석유의 비축을 위탁한 경우에는 그 비축을 위탁한 석유 양에 해당하는 석유저장시설은 해당 석유정제업의 등록을 하려는 자 또는 등록을 한 자의 저장시설로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② When applying Paragraph 1, if a person intending to register or who has registered for the petroleum refining business entrusts the stockpiling of petroleum to a petroleum stockpiling agent pursuant to Article 17 , Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “petroleum stockpiling agent”), the petroleum storage facility corresponding to the amount of petroleum entrusted for stockpiling shall be deemed to be the storage facility of the person intending to register or who has registered for the petroleum refining business.

[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]
[Title Amended December 16, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(석유 내수판매량 및 석유제품 생산량) ① 영 제9조제5항에 따른 석유 내수판매량은 국내에 반입한 석유의 총수입량에서 다음 각 호의 물량을 제외한 후 재고 변동물량을 가감(加減)한 것으로 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2011. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Domestic Sales Volume of Petroleum and Production Volume of Petroleum Products) ① The domestic sales volume of petroleum pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be calculated by adding or subtracting the volume of inventory changes from the total import volume of petroleum brought into the country, after excluding the quantities specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Dec. 30, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수출한 물량(주한 국제연합군 또는 그 밖의 외국군의 기관에 판매하는 경우, 우리나라와 외국 사이를 왕래하는 선박 또는 항공기에 판매하는 경우 및 「남북교류협력에 관한 법률」에 따라 북한으로 반출하는 경우를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Exported quantities (including cases where sold to organizations of the United Nations Forces in Korea or other foreign forces, cases where sold to vessels or aircraft traveling between Korea and foreign countries, and cases where exported to North Korea pursuant to the Act on Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation )

rows.source_ko: 2. 다른 석유정제업자, 석유수출입업자 또는 부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업자에게 영 제20조에 따라 고시한 석유비축의무량(이하 “석유비축의무량”이라 한다)의 비축용으로 판매한 물량
rows.text_en: 2. Volume sold to other petroleum refiners, petroleum importers/exporters, or producers and sellers of petroleum products as by- products for the purpose of stockpiling the mandatory petroleum reserves notified pursuant to Article 20 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “mandatory petroleum reserves”).

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제9조제5항에 따른 석유제품 생산량은 석유제품의 총생산량에서 석유정제업자가 석유정제시설을 가동하기 위하여 연료로 사용한 물량을 제외한 것으로 한다. <개정 2011. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The production volume of petroleum products under Article 9 , Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be the total production volume of petroleum products excluding the volume used as fuel by a petroleum refiner to operate petroleum refining facilities. <Amended Dec. 30, 2011>
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(석유수출입업의 등록 신청) ① 법 제9조제1항 본문에 따라 석유수출입업의 등록을 하려는 자는 석유의 최초 수입통관 예정일 30일 전에 별지 제3호서식의 석유수출입업 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Registration of Petroleum Import/Export Business) ①Any person who intends to register for the petroleum import/export business pursuant to the main text of Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, 30 days prior to the scheduled date of the first import clearance of petroleum, an application for registration of the petroleum import/export business in the form of Annex 3 (including an application in the form of an electronic document), with the following documents (including electronic documents) attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업계획서
rows.text_en: 1. Business Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 수입대행계약서(석유 수입을 대행하는 경우에만 첨부한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Import Agency Agreement (Attach only if acting as an agent for petroleum import)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 한국석유관리원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16.>
rows.text_en: ② The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only to corporations) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . <Amended Dec. 16, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항제1호의 사업계획서에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The business plan referred to in Paragraph 1, Item 1 shall include the following items:

rows.source_ko: 1. 석유저장시설의 현황 자료 또는 건설 및 보유계획(소재지 및 저장능력을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Current status data of petroleum storage facilities or plans for construction and retention (including location and storage capacity)

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 연도 이후 5년간의 석유 수급계획(수출입 및 판매 계획을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Petroleum supply and demand plan for the five years following the relevant year (including import, export, and sales plans)
④ Deleted <December 16, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 석유수출입업의 석유 내수판매량 산출방법에 관하여는 제7조제1항을 준용한다. 이 경우 “영 제9조제5항”은 “영 제12조제4항”으로 본다. <개정 2011. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The provisions of Article 7, Paragraph 1 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the method of calculating the domestic sales volume of petroleum for the petroleum import and export business . In this case, “ Article 9, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree ” shall be deemed “ Article 12, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree .” <Amended Dec. 30, 2011>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 한국석유관리원은 신청내용을 확인하고 그 결과를 주된 영업소의 소재지를 관할하는 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, shall verify the contents of the application and notify the results to the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Governor of a Province, or Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province having jurisdiction over the location of the principal place of business (hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/Governor of the City/Province”). <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제6항에 따른 통지를 받은 시ㆍ도지사는 석유수출입업의 등록을 한 경우에는 해당 신청인에게 별지 제3호의2서식의 석유수출입업 등록증을 발급하고 그 사실을 한국석유관리원에 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ Upon receiving the notice pursuant to Paragraph 6, the Mayor or Provincial Governor who has registered the petroleum import/export business shall issue a Petroleum Import/Export Business Registration Certificate in the form of Annex 3-2 to the relevant applicant and notify the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority of such fact. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 제7항에 따른 통지를 받은 한국석유관리원은 별지 제3호의3서식의 석유수출입업 등록대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority that has received the notice pursuant to Paragraph 7 shall record the fact in the petroleum import/export business registration ledger in the form of Annex 3-3 .
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(석유수출입업의 변경등록) ① 법 제9조제2항에 따라 석유수출입업의 변경등록을 하려는 자는 영 제11조 각 호의 사항이 변경된 날부터 30일 이내에 별지 제4호서식의 석유수출입업 변경등록신청서에 변경내용을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 8. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Change Registration of Petroleum Import/Export Business) ① A person who intends to register a change in petroleum import/export business pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit an application for change registration of petroleum import/export business in the form of Annex 4, attached with documents proving the details of the change, to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority within 30 days from the date on which the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 11 of the Enforcement Decree are changed . <Amended Aug. 12, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 한국석유관리원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(영 제11조제2호의 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16.>
rows.text_en: ② The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration ( applicable only to the case under Article 11, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . <Amended Dec. 16, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 한국석유관리원은 신청내용을 확인하고 그 결과를 시ㆍ도지사에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, shall verify the contents of the application and notify the Mayor or Provincial Governor of the results. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따른 통지를 받은 시ㆍ도지사는 석유수출입업의 변경등록을 한 경우에는 해당 신청인에게 석유수출입업 등록증을 재발급(석유수출입업 등록증의 기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)하고 그 사실을 한국석유관리원에 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ④ Upon receiving the notice pursuant to Paragraph 3, the Mayor or Provincial Governor who has registered a change of petroleum import/export business shall reissue the petroleum import/export business registration certificate to the relevant applicant (only applicable if the details on the petroleum import/export business registration certificate have been changed) and notify the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority of such fact. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항에 따른 통지를 받은 한국석유관리원은 석유수출입업 등록대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority that has received the notice pursuant to Paragraph 4 shall record the fact in the petroleum import/export business registration ledger.
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의2(석유수출입업의 저장시설 범위) ① 영 제12조제4항에 따른 저장시설은 석유수출입업의 등록을 하려는 자 또는 등록을 한 자가 소유하거나 1년 이상의 기간을 정하여 임차한 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 시설을 말한다. 이 경우 저장시설을 여러 석유수출입업자가 공동으로 사용하는 경우도 포함하되, 해당 저장시설의 총용량은 각 석유수출입업자의 사용용량을 모두 합한 것보다 많아야 한다. <개정 2011. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 9-2 (Scope of Storage Facilities for Petroleum Import/Export Business) ① Storage facilities pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree refer to any of the facilities falling under any of the following subparagraphs, owned by or leased for a fixed period of one year or more by a person intending to register or who has registered for the petroleum import/export business. In this case, cases where storage facilities are used jointly by multiple petroleum import/export business operators are included, provided that the total capacity of said storage facilities must be greater than the sum of the usage capacities of each petroleum import/export business operator. <Amended Dec. 30, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「위험물안전관리법」 제6조제1항에 따른 설치허가를 받은 저장소(이동탱크저장소는 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Storage facilities that have received installation permission pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 1 of the "Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act" (excluding mobile tank storage facilities)

rows.source_ko: 2. 「고압가스 안전관리법」 제3조제3호에 따른 저장탱크 중 석유가스나 천연가스를 저장하는 석유저장시설
rows.text_en: 2. Petroleum storage facilities storing petroleum gas or natural gas among storage tanks under Article 3 , Subparagraph 3 of the High-Pressure Gas Safety Management Act
3. Deleted <July 29, 2015>

rows.text_en: ② In cases where a person registered for the petroleum import/export business intends to register a change pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Act due to any of the reasons falling under any of the following subparagraphs , the petroleum storage facility to be changed or increased shall be a facility falling under any of the subparagraphs of Paragraph 1 that is owned or leased by the person registered for the petroleum import/export business. <Newly added Sep. 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 1. 등록된 석유저장시설 소재지의 변경
rows.text_en: 1. Change of location of registered petroleum storage facility

rows.source_ko: 2. 등록된 석유저장시설 규모의 100분의 20 이상의 증가
rows.text_en: 2. An increase of 20% or more in the size of registered oil storage facilities

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항을 적용할 때 석유수출입업의 등록을 하려는 자 또는 등록을 한 자가 석유비축대행업자에게 석유의 비축을 위탁한 경우에는 그 비축을 위탁한 석유 양에 해당하는 석유저장시설은 해당 석유수출입업의 등록을 하려는 자 또는 등록을 한 자의 저장시설로 본다. <개정 2014. 9. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ When applying Paragraphs 1 and 2, if a person intending to register or who has registered for the petroleum import/export business entrusts the stockpiling of petroleum to a petroleum stockpiling agent, the petroleum storage facility corresponding to the amount of petroleum entrusted for stockpiling shall be deemed to be the storage facility of the person intending to register or who has registered for the petroleum import/export business. <Amended Sep. 22, 2014>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 16, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(국내 생산이 현저히 부족한 석유제품) 영 제12조제1항제2호다목에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 석유제품”이란 항공유(경비행기 연료 또는 이와 유사한 용도로 사용하는 것만 해당한다)를 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Petroleum products with significantly insufficient domestic production) In Article 12, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2, Item (c ) of the Enforcement Decree , the term “petroleum products prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” refers to aviation fuel (limited to fuel for light aircraft or used for similar purposes). <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(국제석유거래업의 신고 및 변경신고) ① 법 제9조의2제1항에 따라 국제석유거래업의 신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제5호서식의 국제석유거래업 신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Reporting and Amendment of International Petroleum Trading Business) ①Any person who intends to report an international petroleum trading business pursuant to Article 9-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority an international petroleum trading business report form (including a report form in electronic form) in Annex No. 5 , attaching the documents in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents).

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업계획서
rows.text_en: 1. Business Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 보세구역에서의 석유저장시설의 소유ㆍ임차현황 자료(독점적인 사용권을 가지고 있는 시설임을 증명하는 서류를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Data on the ownership and lease status of petroleum storage facilities in bonded areas (including documents proving that the facility holds exclusive usage rights)

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제9조의2제2항에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 9-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act , “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 성명 또는 상호(법 제9조의2제3항에서 준용하는 법 제7조에 따라 국제석유거래업자의 지위가 승계된 경우에는 그 지위를 승계한 자의 성명 또는 상호를 말한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Name or trade name ( in cases where the status of an international petroleum trader has been succeeded pursuant to Article 7 of the Act applied mutatis mutandis in Article 9-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act , it refers to the name or trade name of the person who has succeeded to such status)

rows.source_ko: 2. 대표자(법인인 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Representative (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 3. 주된 영업소의 소재지
rows.text_en: 3. Location of the principal place of business

rows.source_ko: 4. 석유저장시설의 소재지 또는 규모의 변경
rows.text_en: 4. Change in location or scale of petroleum storage facilities

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제9조의2제2항에 따라 국제석유거래업의 변경신고를 하려는 자는 제2항 각 호의 사항이 변경된 날부터 30일 이내에 별지 제5호의2서식의 국제석유거래업 변경신고서에 변경내용을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Any person who intends to report a change in international petroleum trading business pursuant to Article 9-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit a report on a change in international petroleum trading business in the form of Annex 5-2 to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority within 30 days from the date on which the matters in each subparagraph of Paragraph 2 are changed, attaching documents proving the details of the change.

rows.source_ko: ④ 한국석유관리원은 제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따라 국제석유거래업의 신고 또는 변경신고를 받은 경우에는 해당 신고인에게 별지 제5호의3서식의 국제석유거래업 신고확인증을 발급하거나 재발급(국제석유거래업 신고확인증의 기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)하고 별지 제5호의4서식의 국제석유거래업 신고대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ When the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority receives a report or a change report of international petroleum trading business in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 1 through 3, it shall issue or reissue an international petroleum trading business report confirmation certificate in Form No. 5-3 of the attached annex to the relevant reporter (only applicable if the details on the international petroleum trading business report confirmation certificate have been changed) and record the fact in the international petroleum trading business report ledger in Form No. 5-4 of the attached annex .
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 19, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(석유판매업의 등록 및 신고 등) ① 법 제10조제1항 본문에 따른 석유판매업 중 일반대리점 및 용제대리점의 등록을 하려는 자는 별지 제6호서식의 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점) 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 영 별표 2 제1호가목의 비고 제2호에 따라 항만운송관련사업의 등록을 한 자가 선박급유업을 하기 위하여 일반대리점의 등록을 하려는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 항만운송사업등록증 사본으로 대체할 수 있다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2014. 8. 12., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Registration and Reporting of Petroleum Sales Business, etc.) ①person who intends to register a general agency or a solvent agency among the petroleum sales businesses pursuant to the main clause of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority an application for registration of petroleum sales business (general agency/solvent agency) in the form of Annex 6 (including an application in the form of an electronic document), attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents). However, in the case where a person who has registered a port transport-related business pursuant to Note 2 of Subparagraph 1, Item (a) of Annex 2 of the Enforcement Decree intends to register a general agency to engage in ship bunkering business, the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs may be substituted with a copy of the Port Transport Business Registration Certificate. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Aug. 12, 2014; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업계획서(용제대리점의 경우에는 용제를 공급하는 자와 체결한 용제 공급계약의 내용을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Business plan (in the case of a solvent distributor, including the details of the solvent supply contract concluded with the solvent supplier)

rows.source_ko: 2. 부동산 매매계약서, 임대차계약서 및 보험가입 증명서 등 투자내용을 확인할 수 있는 서류(개인사업자인 경우에만 첨부하며, 이하 “투자내용 확인 서류”라 한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Documents verifying investment details, such as real estate sales contracts, lease agreements, and insurance certificates (to be attached only in the case of a sole proprietorship; hereinafter referred to as “documents verifying investment details”)

rows.source_ko: 3. 석유저장시설의 현황 자료 또는 건설 및 보유계획서(독점적인 사용권을 가지고 있는 시설임을 증명하는 서류를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Current status data of petroleum storage facilities or construction and retention plans (including documents proving that the facility holds exclusive usage rights)

rows.source_ko: 4. 수송장비 명세서 또는 보유계획서(독점적인 사용권을 가지고 있는 시설임을 증명하는 서류를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Transport equipment specifications or retention plan (including documents proving that the facility holds exclusive usage rights)

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제10조제1항 본문에 따른 석유판매업 중 주유소의 등록을 하려는 자는 별지 제7호서식의 석유판매업(주유소) 등록신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다)에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 「경제자유구역의 지정 및 운영에 관한 특별법」 제4조제3항에 따라 산업통상부장관이 지정한 경제자유구역(이하 “경제자유구역”이라 한다)에서 주유소의 등록을 하려는 자는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 8. 12., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to register a gas station among the petroleum sales businesses pursuant to the main clause of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for registration of petroleum sales business (gas station) in the form of Annex 7, attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district; hereinafter the same applies). However, any person who intends to register a gas station in an Economic Free Zone designated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 3 of the Special Act on the Designation and Operation of Economic Free Zones (hereinafter referred to as “Economic Free Zone”) shall submit it to the Governor of a City or Province. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Aug. 12, 2014; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 지하 석유저장시설의 현황 자료 또는 건설 및 보유계획서(저장시설 및 주유기의 배치도면과 독점적인 사용권을 가지고 있는 시설임을 증명하는 서류를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Current status data or construction and retention plan for underground petroleum storage facilities (including layout drawings of storage facilities and fuel dispensers, and documents proving that the facility holds exclusive usage rights)

rows.source_ko: 2. 주유기 명세서
rows.text_en: 2. Fuel dispenser specifications

rows.source_ko: 3. 공중화장실 명세서 또는 건설계획서
rows.text_en: 3. Public restroom specifications or construction plan

rows.source_ko: 4. 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 영 별표 2 제1호다목의 그 밖의 사항란에 따라 등록 요건을 추가로 정한 경우에는 그 요건에 적합함을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. In cases where the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head has additionally determined registration requirements pursuant to the "Other Matters" column of Item 1, Subparagraph (c) of Annex 2 of the Enforcement Decree, documents proving compliance with such requirements

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제10조제1항 본문에 따른 석유판매업 중 용제판매소의 등록을 하려는 자는 별지 제8호서식의 석유판매업(용제판매소) 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 경제자유구역에서 용제판매소의 등록을 하려는 자는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 8. 12.>
rows.text_en: ③ Any person who intends to register a solvent sales outlet among the petroleum sales businesses under the main clause of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for registration of petroleum sales business (solvent sales outlet) in the form of Annex No. 8 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents). However, a person who intends to register a solvent sales outlet in an Economic Free Zone shall submit it to the Governor of a City or Province. <Amended Aug. 12, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 1. 투자내용 확인 서류(개인사업자인 경우에만 첨부한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Documents confirming investment details (attach only if you are a sole proprietorship)

rows.source_ko: 2. 제7항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents falling under any of the subparagraphs of Paragraph 7

rows.source_ko: 3. 제2호의 서류에 포함된 저장소 또는 취급소가 독점적인 사용권을 가지고 있는 시설임을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving that the storage facility or handling facility included in the documents under Subparagraph 2 is a facility over which exclusive usage rights are held.

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제10조제1항 단서에 따른 부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업의 등록을 하려는 자는 별지 제9호서식의 석유판매업(부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업) 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2014. 8. 12.>
rows.text_en: ④ Any person who intends to register the business of producing and selling petroleum products as by-products pursuant to the proviso to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority the application for registration of the petroleum sales business (business of producing and selling petroleum products as by-products) in the form of Annex No. 9 (including an application in the form of an electronic document), attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents). <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Aug. 12, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업계획서(주산물의 정제공정 및 생산계획, 부산물인 석유제품의 품질확보계획 및 해당 연도 이후 5년간의 부산물인 석유제품의 유종별(油種別) 생산계획 및 판매계획을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Business plan (including the refining process and production plan for the main product, the quality assurance plan for petroleum products as by-products, and the production and sales plans by oil type for petroleum products as by-products for the five years following the relevant year)

rows.source_ko: 2. 투자내용 확인 서류(개인사업자인 경우에만 첨부한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Documents confirming investment details (attach only if you are a sole proprietorship)

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항부터 제4항까지의 규정에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 한국석유관리원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, the Mayor, County Head, or District Head, or the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority that has received an application pursuant to Paragraphs 1 through 4 shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only to corporations) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 법 제10조제1항 본문에 따른 석유판매업 중 부생연료유판매소의 등록을 하려는 자는 별지 제10호서식의 석유판매업(부생연료유판매소) 등록신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 한국석유관리원에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2014. 8. 12., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Any person who intends to register a byproduct fuel oil sales outlet among the petroleum sales businesses under the main text of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for registration of petroleum sales business (byproduct fuel oil sales outlet) in the form of Annex No. 10 to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Aug. 12, 2014; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 석유저장시설의 현황 자료 또는 건설 및 보유계획서(독점적인 사용권을 가지고 있는 시설임을 증명하는 서류를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Current status data of petroleum storage facilities or construction and retention plans (including documents proving that the facility holds exclusive usage rights)

rows.source_ko: 2. 수송장비 명세서 또는 보유계획서(독점적인 사용권을 가지고 있는 시설임을 증명하는 서류를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Transport equipment specifications or retention plan (including documents proving that the facility holds exclusive usage rights)

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 법 제10조제2항에 따른 석유판매업 중 일반판매소, 항공유판매업 또는 특수판매소의 신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제11호서식의 석유판매업(일반판매소ㆍ항공유판매업ㆍ특수판매소) 신고서에 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 서류와 그 서류에 포함된 저장소 또는 취급소가 독점적인 사용권을 가지고 있는 시설임을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 경제자유구역에서 일반판매소, 항공유판매업 또는 특수판매소의 신고를 하려는 자는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 8. 12.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ Any person who intends to report a general sales outlet, aviation fuel sales business, or special sales outlet among the petroleum sales businesses pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head the Report on Petroleum Sales Business (General Sales Outlet, Aviation Fuel Sales Business, Special Sales Outlet) in the Form No. 11 of the Appendix, attaching documents falling under any of the following subparagraphs and documents proving that the storage facility or handling facility included in such documents is a facility for which the Mayor holds exclusive usage rights. However, a person who intends to report a general sales outlet, aviation fuel sales business, or special sales outlet in an Economic Free Zone shall submit it to the Governor of a City or Province. <Amended Aug. 12, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「위험물안전관리법 시행규칙」 별표 6에 따른 옥외탱크저장소의 완공검사필증 사본 및 같은 법 시행규칙 별표 16 Ⅰ제2호마목에 따른 일반취급소의 완공검사필증 사본
rows.text_en: 1. A copy of the certificate of completion inspection for an outdoor tank storage facility pursuant to Annex 6 of the Enforcement Rules of the Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act, and a copy of the certificate of completion inspection for a general handling facility pursuant to Item 2, Subparagraph (e) of Annex 16 I of the Enforcement Rules of the same Act.

rows.source_ko: 2. 「위험물안전관리법 시행규칙」 별표 7에 따른 옥내탱크저장소의 완공검사필증 사본 및 같은 법 시행규칙 별표 16 Ⅰ제2호마목에 따른 일반취급소의 완공검사필증 사본
rows.text_en: 2. A copy of the certificate of completion inspection for an indoor tank storage facility pursuant to Annex 7 of the Enforcement Rule of the Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act, and a copy of the certificate of completion inspection for a general handling facility pursuant to Item 2, Subparagraph (e) of Annex 16 I of the Enforcement Rule of the same Act.

rows.source_ko: 3. 「위험물안전관리법 시행규칙」 별표 8에 따른 지하탱크저장소의 완공검사필증 사본 및 같은 법 시행규칙 별표 16 Ⅰ제2호마목에 따른 일반취급소의 완공검사필증 사본
rows.text_en: 3. A copy of the certificate of completion inspection for underground tank storage facilities pursuant to Annex 8 of the Enforcement Rules of the Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act, and a copy of the certificate of completion inspection for general handling facilities pursuant to Item 2, Subparagraph (e) of Annex 16 I of the Enforcement Rules of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「위험물안전관리법 시행규칙」 별표 9에 따른 간이탱크저장소의 완공검사필증 사본 및 같은 법 시행규칙 별표 16 Ⅰ제2호마목에 따른 일반취급소의 완공검사필증 사본
rows.text_en: 4. A copy of the certificate of completion inspection for a simplified tank storage facility pursuant to Annex 9 of the Enforcement Rule of the Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act, and a copy of the certificate of completion inspection for a general handling facility pursuant to Item 2, Subparagraph (e) of Annex 16 I of the Enforcement Rule of the same Act.

rows.source_ko: 5. 「위험물안전관리법 시행규칙」 별표 14에 따른 판매취급소의 완공검사필증 사본
rows.text_en: 5. Copy of the Certificate of Completion Inspection for the Sales Facility pursuant to Annex 14 of the Enforcement Rule of the Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 「위험물안전관리법 시행규칙」 별표 16 Ⅰ제2호바목에 따른 일반취급소의 완공검사필증 사본
rows.text_en: 6. Copy of the Certificate of Completion Inspection for a General Handling Facility pursuant to Subparagraph 2(f) of Annex I of Table 16 of the Enforcement Rules of the Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제2항ㆍ제3항ㆍ제5항 및 제7항에 따라 석유판매업의 등록을 하거나 신고를 받은 경우에는 별지 제12호서식의 석유판매업(주유소ㆍ용제판매소) 등록대장 또는 별지 제13호서식의 석유판매업(일반판매소ㆍ항공유판매업ㆍ특수판매소) 신고대장(이하 “석유판매업 신고대장”이라 한다)에 그 사실을 기재하고, 해당 신청인 또는 신고인에게 별지 제14호서식의 석유판매업(주유소ㆍ용제판매소) 등록증 또는 별지 제15호서식의 석유판매업(일반판매소ㆍ항공유판매업ㆍ특수판매소) 신고확인증(이하 “석유판매업 신고확인증”이라 한다)을 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ When the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head registers a petroleum sales business or receives a report pursuant to Paragraphs 2, 3, 5, and 7, they shall record such fact in the Register of Registration for Petroleum Sales Business (Gas Stations/Solvent Sales Stations) in Form No. 12 or the Register of Reports for Petroleum Sales Business (General Sales Stations/Aviation Fuel Sales Businesses/Special Sales Stations) in Form No. 13 (hereinafter referred to as the “Petroleum Sales Business Report Register”) and issue a Certificate of Registration for Petroleum Sales Business (Gas Stations/Solvent Sales Stations) in Form No. 14 or a Certificate of Report Confirmation for Petroleum Sales Business (General Sales Stations/Aviation Fuel Sales Businesses/Special Sales Stations) in Form No. 15 (hereinafter referred to as the “Petroleum Sales Business Report Confirmation Certificate”) to the relevant applicant or reporter. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 제1항ㆍ제4항 및 제6항에 따른 신청을 받은 한국석유관리원은 신청내용을 확인하고 그 결과를 산업통상부장관 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 10. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraphs 1, 4, and 6, shall verify the contents of the application and notify the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources or the Mayor/Do Governor of the results. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 19, 2017; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 제9항에 따른 통지를 받은 산업통상부장관 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업ㆍ부생연료유판매소)의 등록을 한 경우에는 해당 신청인에게 석유판매업 등록증을 발급하고 그 사실을 한국석유관리원에 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 10. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: 10. Upon receiving the notice pursuant to Paragraph 9, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources or the Mayor/Do Governor shall, in the event that registration of a petroleum sales business (general agency, solvent agency, business of producing and selling petroleum products as by-products, or by-product fuel oil sales outlet) has been completed, issue a petroleum sales business registration certificate to the relevant applicant and notify the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority of such fact. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 19, 2017; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 제10항에 따른 통지를 받은 한국석유관리원은 별지 제12호서식의 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ부생연료유판매소) 등록대장 및 별지 제16호서식의 석유판매업(부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업) 등록대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: 11. The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving the notice pursuant to Paragraph 10, shall record such fact in the registration ledger for petroleum sales businesses (general agencies, solvent agencies, and byproduct fuel oil sales outlets) in Form No. 12 and the registration ledger for petroleum sales businesses (production and sales of petroleum products as byproducts) in Form No. 16. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 제8항의 석유판매업(주유소ㆍ용제판매소) 등록대장 및 제11항의 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업ㆍ부생연료유판매소) 등록대장(이하 “석유판매업 등록대장”이라 한다)과 석유판매업 신고대장은 전자적 처리가 불가능한 특별한 사유가 있는 경우를 제외하고는 산업통상부장관이 지정하는 전산망을 이용하여 전자적 방법으로 작성ㆍ관리하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 10. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑫ The register of petroleum sales businesses (gas stations and solvent sales outlets) under Paragraph 8 and the register of petroleum sales businesses (general agencies, solvent agencies, businesses producing and selling petroleum products as by-products, and by-product fuel oil sales outlets) under Paragraph 11 (hereinafter referred to as the “Petroleum Sales Business Register”) and the register of reports on petroleum sales businesses shall be prepared and managed electronically using a computer network designated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, except in cases where there are special reasons making electronic processing impossible. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 19, 2017; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑬ 산업통상부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 및 영 제42조의2제5항 또는 제45조제4항부터 제8항까지의 규정에 따라 그 권한을 위탁받은 한국석유관리원이나 「한국석유공사법」에 따른 한국석유공사(이하 “공사”라 한다)는 해당 업무를 수행하기 위하여 필요한 경우에 한정하여 석유판매업 등록대장과 석유판매업 신고대장의 확인을 시ㆍ도지사, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 한국석유관리원에 요청할 수 있다. 이 경우 그 요청을 받은 시ㆍ도지사, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 한국석유관리원은 특별한 사유가 없으면 요청에 따라야 한다. <개정 2012. 5. 14., 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: 13. The Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, the Governor of a City or Province, the Mayor, County Head, or District Head, and the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority or the Korea Petroleum Corporation under the Korea Petroleum Corporation Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Corporation”) , which have been entrusted with such authority pursuant to Article 42-2 , Paragraph 5 or Article 45, Paragraphs 4 through 8 of the Enforcement Decree, may request the Governor of a City or Province, the Mayor, County Head, or District Head, or the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority to verify the ledger of petroleum sales business registrations and the ledger of petroleum sales business notifications, limited to cases where it is necessary to perform the relevant duties. In such cases, the Governor of a City or Province, the Mayor, County Head, or District Head, or the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority receiving the request shall comply with the request unless there are special circumstances. <Amended May 14, 2012; March 23, 2013; October 1, 2025>
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(석유판매업의 변경등록 및 변경신고) ① 법 제10조제3항에 따라 석유판매업의 변경등록 또는 변경신고를 하려는 자는 영 제14조 각 호의 사항이 변경된 날부터 30일 이내에 별지 제17호서식의 석유판매업 변경등록신청서(변경신고서)에 변경내용을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 등록을 하거나 신고를 받은 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업ㆍ부생연료유판매소의 경우에는 한국석유관리원을 말한다)에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2014. 8. 12., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Change Registration and Change Notification of Petroleum Sales Business) ①Any person who intends to register a change or report a change of petroleum sales business pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall , within 30 days from the date on which the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 14 of the Enforcement Decree are changed, submit an Application for Change Registration (or Change Notification) of Petroleum Sales Business in the Form of Annex 17 , accompanied by documents proving the details of the change, to the Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, or Mayor, County Head, or District Head who received the registration or notification (in the case of general agencies, solvent agencies, businesses producing and selling petroleum products as by-products, or by-product fuel oil sales outlets, this refers to the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority). <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Aug. 12, 2014; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청 또는 신고를 받은 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 한국석유관리원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(영 제14조제2호의 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, the Mayor, County Head, or District Head, or the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority that receives an application or report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration ( applicable only to the case of Article 14, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree ) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항 및 제2항에 따라 변경등록을 하거나 변경신고를 받은 경우에는 석유판매업 등록대장 또는 석유판매업 신고대장에 그 사실을 기재하고, 해당 신청인 또는 신고인에게 석유판매업 등록증 또는 석유판매업 신고확인증을 재발급(석유판매업 등록증 또는 석유판매업 신고확인증의 기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ③ When a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, or Mayor, County Head, or District Head registers a change or receives a report of change pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2, they shall record such fact in the Petroleum Sales Business Registration Register or the Petroleum Sales Business Report Register and reissue the Petroleum Sales Business Registration Certificate or the Petroleum Sales Business Report Confirmation Certificate to the relevant applicant or reporter (only applicable if the details on the Petroleum Sales Business Registration Certificate or the Petroleum Sales Business Report Confirmation Certificate have changed). <Amended Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ④ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 「위험물안전관리법 시행규칙」 제24조제2항에 따라 석유판매업(주유소 및 일반판매소를 말한다)에 관한 소방서장의 통보를 받은 경우에는 별지 제12호서식의 석유판매업(주유소) 등록대장 또는 별지 제13호서식의 석유판매업(일반판매소) 신고대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다. <신설 2014. 8. 12.>
rows.text_en: ④ In accordance with Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rules of the Dangerous Goods Safety Management Act, if a Mayor, County Governor, or District Head receives notification from the Head of the Fire Station regarding a petroleum sales business (referring to gas stations and general sales outlets), they shall record such fact in the Petroleum Sales Business (Gas Station) Registration Register ( Form No. 12) or the Petroleum Sales Business (General Sales Outlet) Reporting Register (Form No. 13 ). <Newly added Aug. 12, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항에 따라 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업ㆍ부생연료유판매소)의 변경등록 신청을 받은 한국석유관리원은 신청내용을 확인하고 그 결과를 산업통상부장관 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 8. 12., 2017. 10. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, upon receiving an application for a change of registration for a petroleum sales business (general agency, solvent agency, business of producing and selling petroleum products as by-products, and by-product fuel oil sales outlet) pursuant to Paragraph 1, shall verify the contents of the application and notify the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources or the Mayor/Do Governor of the results. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Aug. 12, 2014; Oct. 19, 2017; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제5항에 따른 통지를 받은 산업통상부장관 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업ㆍ부생연료유판매소)의 변경등록을 한 경우에는 해당 신청인에게 석유판매업 등록증을 재발급(석유판매업 등록증의 기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)하고 그 사실을 한국석유관리원에 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 8. 12., 2017. 10. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Upon receiving the notice pursuant to Paragraph 5, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources or the Mayor/Do Governor shall, in the event of a change registration of a petroleum sales business (general agency, solvent agency, business of producing and selling petroleum products as by-products, or by-product fuel oil sales outlet), reissue the petroleum sales business registration certificate to the relevant applicant (only applicable if the details on the petroleum sales business registration certificate have been changed) and notify the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority of such fact. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Aug. 12, 2014; Oct. 19, 2017; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제6항에 따른 통지를 받은 한국석유관리원은 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업ㆍ부생연료유판매소) 등록대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2014. 8. 12., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority, having received the notice pursuant to Paragraph 6, shall record such fact in the registration ledger of petroleum sales businesses (general agencies, solvent agencies, businesses producing and selling petroleum products as by-products, and by-product fuel oil sales outlets). <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Aug. 12, 2014; Oct. 19, 2017>
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(조건부 등록 신청 및 그 처리기간) ① 영 제16조제2항에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 서류”란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Application for Conditional Registration and Processing Period Thereof) ① The term “documents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” in Article 16, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the documents classified according to each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 석유정제업의 조건부 등록 신청: 제4조제1항의 사업계획서 및 같은 조 제4항 각 호의 서류 및 별지 제1호서식에 따른 조건부 등록신청서
rows.text_en: 1. Application for Conditional Registration of Petroleum Refining Business: Business plan pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 , and the documents specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 4 of the same article , and the application for conditional registration in accordance with Form No. 1.

rows.source_ko: 2. 석유수출입업의 조건부 등록 신청: 제8조제1항 각 호 및 같은 조 제3항 각 호의 서류 및 별지 제3호서식에 따른 조건부 등록신청서
rows.text_en: 2. Application for Conditional Registration of Petroleum Import/Export Business: Documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 8, Paragraph 1 and each subparagraph of Article 8, Paragraph 3 , and the application for conditional registration in accordance with Form No. 3.

rows.source_ko: 3. 석유판매업(일반대리점, 용제대리점)의 조건부 등록 신청: 제12조제1항 각 호의 서류 및 별지 제6호서식에 따른 조건부 등록신청서
rows.text_en: 3. Application for Conditional Registration of Petroleum Sales Business (General Agency, Solvent Agency): Documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 12, Paragraph 1 , and the application for conditional registration in accordance with Form No. 6.

rows.source_ko: 4. 석유판매업(주유소)의 조건부 등록 신청: 제12조제2항 각 호의 서류 및 별지 제7호서식에 따른 조건부 등록신청서
rows.text_en: 4. Application for Conditional Registration of Petroleum Sales Business (Gas Station): Documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 12, Paragraph 2 , and the application for conditional registration in accordance with Form No. 7.

rows.source_ko: 5. 석유판매업(부생연료유판매소)의 조건부 등록 신청: 제12조제6항 각 호의 서류 및 별지 제10호서식에 따른 조건부 등록신청서
rows.text_en: 5. Application for Conditional Registration of Petroleum Sales Business (By-product Fuel Oil Sales Outlet): Documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 12, Paragraph 6 , and the application for conditional registration in accordance with Form No. 10.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항 각호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 신청을 받은 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 한국석유관리원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, County Head, or District Head, or the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority that receives an application falling under any of the subparagraphs of Paragraph 1 shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only to corporations) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제11조제2항에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 기간을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources” refers to the period classified according to each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 석유정제업 또는 석유수출입업의 조건부 등록 신청: 14일
rows.text_en: 1. Application for conditional registration of petroleum refining or petroleum import/export business: 14 days

rows.source_ko: 2. 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ주유소 및 부생연료유판매소)의 조건부 등록 신청: 7일
rows.text_en: 2. Application for conditional registration of petroleum sales business (general agencies, solvent agencies, gas stations, and byproduct fuel oil sales outlets): 7 days
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(사업의 개시ㆍ휴업 및 폐업신고) ① 법 제12조제2항에 따라 사업의 개시ㆍ휴업 또는 폐업 신고를 하려는 자는 신고사유가 발생한 날부터 30일 이내에 별지 제18호서식의 석유정제업(석유수출입업ㆍ국제석유거래업ㆍ석유판매업) 사업개시(휴업ㆍ폐업) 신고서를 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 자에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 법 제9조제1항 단서에 따라 석유수출입업의 등록이 면제된 자와 법 제9조의2제1항 단서에 따라 국제석유거래업의 신고가 면제된 자의 경우에는 그러하지 아니하다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2014. 8. 12., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Reporting of Commencement, Suspension, and Closure of Business) ①Any person who intends to report the commencement, suspension, or closure of business pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit the Reporting of Commencement (Suspension/Closure) of Petroleum Refining Business (Petroleum Import/Export Business, International Petroleum Trading Business, Petroleum Sales Business) in the form of Annex No. 18 to the persons classified under each of the following subparagraphs within 30 days from the date the cause for reporting occurred. However, this shall not apply to persons exempted from registration of the petroleum import/export business pursuant to the proviso to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act , and persons exempted from reporting the international petroleum trading business pursuant to the proviso to Article 9-2 , Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Aug. 12, 2014; Oct. 19, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 석유정제업, 석유수출입업, 국제석유거래업 및 부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업: 한국석유관리원
rows.text_en: 1. Petroleum refining, petroleum import and export, international petroleum trading, and production and sale of petroleum products as by-products: Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority

rows.source_ko: 2. 석유판매업(일반대리점, 용제대리점 또는 부생연료유판매소 및 경제자유구역에서 등록하거나 신고한 주유소, 일반판매소, 용제판매소, 항공유판매업 또는 특수판매소만 해당한다): 등록을 하거나 신고를 받은 시ㆍ도지사
rows.text_en: 2. Petroleum sales business (limited to general agencies, solvent agencies, or byproduct fuel oil sales outlets, and gas stations, general sales outlets, solvent sales outlets, aviation fuel sales businesses, or special sales outlets registered or reported in Free Economic Zones): The Mayor or Provincial Governor who received the registration or report

rows.source_ko: 3. 석유판매업(제2호를 제외한 주유소, 일반판매소, 용제판매소, 항공유판매업 또는 특수판매소만 해당한다): 등록을 하거나 신고를 받은 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장
rows.text_en: 3. Petroleum sales business (applicable only to gas stations, general sales outlets, solvent sales outlets, aviation fuel sales businesses, or special sales outlets excluding those in Subparagraph 2): The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head who has registered or received a report

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신고를 받은 시ㆍ도지사, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 한국석유관리원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 사업자등록증(사업을 개시하는 경우만 해당한다)을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신고인이 사업자등록증의 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 신고인이 직접 그 사본을 첨부하게 하여야 한다. <신설 2012. 10. 5.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor/Do Governor, Mayor/Gun Head/District Head, or the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority receiving a report under Paragraph 1 shall verify the business registration certificate (only applicable in cases of business commencement) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the reporting person does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, the reporting person shall be required to attach a copy thereof directly. <Newly added Oct. 5, 2012>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 신고를 받은 시ㆍ도지사, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 한국석유관리원은 석유정제업 등록대장, 석유정제업 신고대장, 국제석유거래업 신고대장, 석유수출입업 등록대장, 석유판매업 등록대장 또는 석유판매업 신고대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다. <개정 2012. 10. 5., 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor/Do Governor, Mayor/Gun Head/District Head, or the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority who receives a report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall record such fact in the Petroleum Refining Business Registration Register, the Petroleum Refining Business Report Register, the International Petroleum Trading Business Report Register, the Petroleum Import/Export Business Registration Register, the Petroleum Sales Business Registration Register, or the Petroleum Sales Business Report Register. <Amended Oct. 5, 2012; Oct. 19, 2017>
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제16조(석유정제업자 등에 대한 행정처분기준) 법 제13조제5항에 따른 행정처분기준은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Petroleum Refiners, etc.) The standards for administrative dispositions pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 5 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended Oct. 19, 2017>
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(석유정제업자 등에 대한 과징금의 부과기준 및 산정기준) ① 법 제14조에 따라 부과하는 과징금의 부과기준 및 산정기준은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Criteria for Imposing and Calculating Surcharges on Petroleum Refiners, etc.) ①The criteria for imposing and calculating surcharges imposed pursuant to Article 14 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 산업통상부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 사업 규모, 위반 정도 및 위반횟수 등을 고려하여 제1항에 따른 과징금 금액의 2분의 1의 범위에서 과징금을 가중하거나 감경할 수 있다. 다만, 가중하는 경우에도 과징금의 총액은 법 제14조제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에서 정하는 금액을 초과할 수 없다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head may increase or decrease the penalty surcharge under Paragraph 1 within the range of one-half of the amount, taking into consideration the scale of the business, the degree of violation, and the frequency of violations. However, even in the case of increase, the total amount of the penalty surcharge shall not exceed the amount prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 3 of Article 14 of the Act . <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 산업통상부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제14조제1항 단서에 따라 석유정제업자ㆍ석유수출입업자ㆍ국제석유거래업자 또는 석유판매업자가 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 사업정지처분을 갈음하여 과징금을 부과할 수 없다. <신설 2012. 5. 14., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 7. 29., 2017. 10. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Pursuant to the proviso to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head may not impose an penalty surcharge in lieu of a business suspension order if a petroleum refiner, petroleum importer/exporter, international petroleum trader, or petroleum seller falls under any of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added May 14, 2012; March 23, 2013; July 29, 2015; October 19, 2017; October 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제29조제1항제1호를 위반하여 착색제(着色劑)를 제거ㆍ첨가하거나 식별제(識別劑)를 제거할 수 있는 시설ㆍ장치 등을 설치ㆍ개조하여 가짜석유제품을 제조ㆍ판매한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of manufacturing or selling counterfeit petroleum products by installing or modifying facilities or devices capable of removing coloring agents or removing identification agents in violation of Article 29, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제30조제1항에 따른 명령을 위반하거나 봉인을 훼손한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of violating an order pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 1 of the Act or damaging a seal

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제39조제1항제1호를 위반하여 가짜석유제품 제조 등을 목적으로 영업시설을 설치ㆍ개조하거나 그 설치ㆍ개조한 영업시설을 양수ㆍ임차하여 사용하는 행위
rows.text_en: 3. The act of installing or modifying business facilities for the purpose of manufacturing counterfeit petroleum products, etc., in violation of Article 39, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act , or acquiring or leasing and using such installed or modified business facilities.

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제39조제1항제4호를 위반하여 정량 미달 판매 또는 부당 부피 증가 판매를 목적으로 영업시설을 설치ㆍ개조하거나 그 설치ㆍ개조한 영업시설을 양수ㆍ임차하여 사용하는 행위
rows.text_en: 4. The act of installing or modifying business facilities, or acquiring or leasing such installed or modified business facilities, for the purpose of selling less than the specified quantity or selling with an unfair increase in volume in violation of Article 39, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act.
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제18조(과징금의 부과ㆍ징수 절차) ① 산업통상부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제14조제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따라 과징금을 부과하려면 과징금을 낼 것을 서면으로 통지하여야 한다. 이 경우 서면에는 위반행위의 종류와 과징금의 금액을 분명하게 적어야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Procedures for Imposition and Collection of Surcharges) ① If the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head intends to impose a surcharge pursuant to the provisions of Article 14 , Paragraphs 1 through 3 of the Act , they shall notify the person concerned in writing that the surcharge be paid. In such cases, the written notice shall clearly state the type of violation and the amount of the surcharge. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 통지를 받은 자는 통지를 받은 날부터 20일 이내에 과징금을 산업통상부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 정하는 수납기관에 내야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2023. 12. 12., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who has received notice pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall pay the penalty surcharge to the receiving agency designated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head within 20 days from the date of receiving the notice. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Dec. 12, 2023; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 과징금을 받은 수납기관은 그 납부자에게 영수증을 발급하고, 지체 없이 그 사실을 산업통상부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The receiving agency that has received an penalty surcharge pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall issue a receipt to the payer and notify the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head of such fact without delay. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
④ Deleted <December 12, 2023>
⑤ Deleted <December 16, 2010>
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제19조(관계 행정기관에 대한 협조요청) 산업통상부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제13조ㆍ제14조에 따른 행정처분을 하기 위하여 필요한 경우에는 관계 행정기관에 그 위반사항의 조사에 필요한 협조를 요청할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Request for Cooperation from Relevant Administrative Agencies) The Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head may request relevant administrative agencies to provide cooperation necessary for the investigation of violations if necessary to take administrative action pursuant to Articles 13 and 14 of the Act . <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
[Wholly Amended May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의2(행정처분 기록의 관리) ① 산업통상부장관 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제13조에 따른 등록의 취소 등을 하거나 법 제14조에 따른 과징금을 부과한 경우에는 한국석유관리원에 그 사실을 통지하여야 하고, 한국석유관리원은 석유정제업 등록대장, 석유정제업 신고대장, 석유수출입업 등록대장, 국제석유거래업 신고대장, 석유판매업(일반대리점ㆍ용제대리점ㆍ부산물인 석유제품 생산판매업ㆍ부생연료유판매소) 등록대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 12. 16., 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 10. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 19-2 (Management of Records of Administrative Dispositions) ① When the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources or the Governor of a City or Province cancels a registration, etc., pursuant to Article 13 of the Act or imposes a penalty surcharge pursuant to Article 14 of the Act , they shall notify the Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority of such fact. The Korea Petroleum Quality & Distribution Authority shall record such fact in the Register of Petroleum Refining Businesses, the Register of Reports of Petroleum Refining Businesses, the Register of Registrations of Petroleum Import/Export Businesses, the Register of Reports of International Petroleum Trading Businesses, and the Register of Registrations of Petroleum Sales Businesses (General Agencies, Solvent Agencies, Businesses Producing and Selling Petroleum Products as By-products, and Sales Outlets for By-product Fuel Oil). <Amended Dec. 16, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 19, 2017; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장, 특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제13조에 따른 등록의 취소 등을 하거나 법 제14조에 따른 과징금을 부과한 경우에는 석유판매업(주유소ㆍ용제판매소) 등록대장 또는 석유판매업 신고대장에 그 사실을 기재하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 10. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head shall record in the petroleum sales business (gas station, solvent sales station) registration ledger or the petroleum sales business report ledger any cancellation of registration, etc., pursuant to Article 13 of the Act or the imposition of an penalty surcharge pursuant to Article 14 of the Act that such fact has been recorded. <Amended Oct. 19, 2017>
[This Article Newly Inserted May 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의3(게시문의 내용 등) 법 제14조의2에 따른 게시문의 내용, 게시 장소 등은 별표 2의2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 19-3 (Contents of Posting, etc.) The contents of postings, posting locations, etc. pursuant to Article 14-2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2-2 .
[This Article Newly Inserted May 14, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제3장 석유비축
rows.text_en: Chapter 3 Oil Stockpiling

rows.source_ko: 제20조(공사의 석유비축사업) ① 법 제16조제2항에 따라 공사는 다음 각 호의 사업을 수행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Petroleum Stockpiling Business of the Corporation) ① Pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Corporation shall carry out the following businesses:

rows.source_ko: 1. 원유 및 석유제품의 비축을 위한 수출입ㆍ비축ㆍ수송 및 대여 사업
rows.text_en: 1. Import/export, stockpiling, transportation, and leasing business for the stockpiling of crude oil and petroleum products

rows.source_ko: 2. 석유비축시설의 건설ㆍ관리ㆍ운영 및 대여 사업
rows.text_en: 2. Construction, management, operation, and leasing business of petroleum storage facilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1호 또는 제2호의 사업에 딸린 사업
rows.text_en: 3. Business attached to the business under Subparagraph 1 or 2

rows.source_ko: ② 산업통상부장관은 법 제16조제1항에 따른 석유비축시책을 시행하기 위하여 필요하면 공사로 하여금 제1항제1호 및 제2호의 사업으로 발생하는 이익을 비축유의 구입과 비축시설의 신설 및 증설에 우선 사용하도록 할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② If necessary to implement the petroleum stockpiling policy under Article 16 , Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources may require the Corporation to use the profits generated from the projects under Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1 and 2 preferentially for the purchase of stockpiled oil and the construction and expansion of stockpiling facilities. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 산업통상부장관은 법 제16조제3항에 따른 안전성 검사를 위하여 필요한 경우 다음 각 호의 사항에 관한 자체 점검 결과를 공사로부터 제출받을 수 있다. <신설 2014. 8. 12., 2025. 10. 1.>
